transcript: Three things you should say to yourself every morning, and your entire day will look different. My friends, the first minutes of the day set the tone for everything that comes after. If you want these words to become a real habit, save this video and come back to it every morning until these sentences settle inside you. Number one, this is going to be the best day of my life, not because it will be perfect, but because I will show up fully present and willing to learn from whatever the day brings. Number two, I control my mind. It does not control me. I do not control what will happen, but I control how I respond, and I choose to respond with joy and love to whatever happens. And the third thing, I am grateful for what I have right now, even if it is something small, even if the day is not perfect. These three sentences are simple, but if you return to them again and again throughout the day, the way you feel, the way you respond and the way you live will begin to change. And if you feel that your heart is ready for a deeper and more structured process, I invite you to the 30-day healing journey. The link is in the profile. Remember, my friends, life does not change in one day, but the right direction chosen again every morning changes everything.
